The '''Rampa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rampa III]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' created the [[Rampa Minor system/Legends|Rampa Minor system]] to differentiate [[Rampa 1]] and [[Rampa 2]] from Rampa III, establishing that they are not in the same system.<ref name="TEA" />
